title: It's Not Easy Being Me — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal observational English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
People think it's easy being me
Standing at the front of every family scene
Dad on the phone, Dad on the group, Dad getting tagged
It's not easy being me — and nobody asked

[Verse 2 — Español]
La gente cree que es fácil ser yo [People think it's easy being me]
Al frente de cada escena familiar estoy yo [At the front of every family scene, there I am]
Papá en el teléfono, papá en el grupo, papá siendo etiquetado [Dad on the phone, Dad on the group, Dad getting tagged]
No es fácil ser yo — y nadie preguntó [It's not easy being me — and nobody asked]

[Chorus — English]
It's not easy being me
The jazz is in my blood and the words come free
Three sons and a garden and Wilma by my side
It's not easy being me — but I wouldn't change the ride

[Bridge — Français]
Les gens croient que c'est facile d'être moi [People think it's easy being me]
Debout devant chaque scène de famille [Standing at the front of every family scene]
Papa au téléphone, Papa dans le groupe, Papa tagué [Dad on the phone, Dad in the group, Dad being tagged]
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi — mais je suis le roi [It's not easy being me — but I am the king]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pete's up on his charter, Joel's in hospital, Corey's on the beach
Wilma's in the garden and somehow I'm in reach
Of all three boys at once from a phone that won't stop
It's not easy being me — but I'm still at the top

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
It's not easy being me
No es fácil ser yo [It's not easy being me]
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi [It's not easy being me]
That's my boy
